person_note: The controlling narration is Saeris Fane's first-person past-tense account. Numerous Goodreads passages expose her as an acting and perceiving I/me/my narrator, and a sustained authorized interior excerpt independently shows the same voice. Whole-book structural sources identify Saeris as the narrator or state that the story remains entirely in her perspective. Most contrary-looking pronouns in the quote set occur in dialogue, telepathic speech, generic maxims, or in-world address and therefore do not determine base person. The isolated Carrion self-introduction lacks reliable local context, while reported Kingfisher material consists of separately released bonus chapters; neither establishes sustained narration in another grammatical person. The main residual uncertainty is the precise provenance of those isolated quotations and edition-specific inclusion of bonus material, but all securely identified narrative voices are first person, so this does not affect the FIRST label.
